_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 10 가정법에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 7과 가정법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 가정법 과거: If+주어+동사의 과거형 ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+동사원형
가정법 과거완료: If+주어+had p.p. ~, 주어+조동사 과거형+have p.p.
without[but for] = if it were not for / if it had not been for

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If I ______ how to bake bread, I would make some for you.

choices.text: know
knew
had known
have known
will bake

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If we had left home earlier, we ______ the first train.

choices.text: had caught
will catch
have caught
would catch
would have caught

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 통하지 않는 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: If he had a map, he could find the way. → He doesn’t have a map, so he can’t find the way.
If Mina spoke kindly, many people would like her. → Many people don’t like Mina because she speaks kindly.
If I had left early, I would not have missed the train. → As I didn’t leave early, I missed the train.
If the café didn’t close early, I could have coffee there. → Because the café closes early, I cannot have coffee there.
If Kate had checked the map, she would not have gotten lost. → Kate didn’t check the map, so she got lost.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: If Nara hadn’t missed the bus last night, she [[could have]] more time to prepare for the test.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: If you listened carefully, you [[won’t ask]] the same question.

questions.point_label: I wish, as if, 가정법 과거완료
questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: 그 도서관이 일요일에 문을 열면 좋을 텐데. → I wish the library opens on Sunday.
그 그림 속의 새는 마치 날고 있는 것처럼 보인다. → The bird in the painting looks as if it were flying.
Jay가 조심했다면, 컵을 깨뜨리지 않았을 텐데. → If Jay were careful, he would not have broken the cup.
Sam이 안경을 썼다면, 칠판을 볼 수 있었을 텐데. → If Sam had worn his glasses, he could have seen the board.
내가 바쁘지 않다면, 나는 친구들과 영화를 보러 갈 수 있을 텐데. → I could go to the movies with my friends if I had not been busy.

questions.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: I won’t ask her for help because she is tired these days.
→ If she ________ tired these days, I ________ her for help.

questions.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: As Tom missed the last practice, he couldn’t play in the match.
→ If Tom ________ the last practice, he ________ in the match.
questions.answer: had not[hadn’t] missed, could have played

questions.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: I’m sorry I can’t join the trip this weekend.
→ I wish ________________ the trip this weekend.

questions.point_label: without = if it had not been for
questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>와 의미가 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> Without your advice, I could not have solved the problem.

choices.text: But for your advice, I could have solved the problem.
If it were for your advice, I could not have solved the problem.
Had it not been for your advice, I could have solved the problem.
If it had not been for your advice, I could not solved the problem.
If it had not been for your advice, I could not have solved the problem.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 가정법 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 내가 형이 있다면, 형에게 내 고민을 털어놓을 수 있을 텐데. (share, can, an older brother, have, if)
questions.answer: If I had an older brother, I could share

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 가정법 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 내가 더 부지런했다면, 그 대회에 참가했을 텐데. (take part in, more diligent, if, be, will)
questions.answer: If I had been more diligent, I would have taken part in

questions.point_label: if it were not for의 주절
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I wish I could meet my old teacher again.
What would happen if it snowed every day?
James talks as if the singer were his cousin.
If I had set the alarm, I wouldn’t have overslept.
If it were not for the coach’s advice, my score would have been worse.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I wish my dad bought me a new bike.
Henry looks as if he hadn’t eaten at all today.
Were it a holiday today, I would sleep all day.
If we were on the same team, we won’t lose the match.
Had I packed my bag carefully, I might not have forgotten my towel.
